name: gh-issue-driven
description: Orchestrate a full GitHub-issue-driven dev workflow — propose issues from session context (phase 0), design review (gate1), branch (single or multi-issue batch), implement, pre-PR review battery (gate2), PR creation, pluggable post-PR reviewer (Copilot / /code-review) with HITL invocation gate for honest Copilot orchestration, release checklist as a dogfooding gate before tagging, and per-repo Kagura Memory context persistence with auto-detect setup.
